StartPause

Plug in or pair any Xbox, PlayStation or other standard controller and press a button. Gas, brake and steering are analogue. In the menus the d-pad moves, A selects and B goes back.

On a phone use the buttons on the screen: ◀ ▶ steer, GAS, BRK, DRIFT and NOS.

Drifting and the blue pads fill your nitro. Hit the gas just before “GO!” for a super start. Turn in too fast and the front washes wide; too much power swings the tail out. Hold a slide with the gas, steer into the corner for more angle or counter-steer to straighten up. In the rain everything grips less, and crashes damage the car.

RACE OPTIONS

Extra rules for your races. In multiplayer the host picks them for everyone.

Hit a corner and the steering bends: the car pulls towards the side that took the most damage. Front hits bend it the most.

Blue arrow pads on the straights: drive over one for a burst of speed and some nitro.
